meta.title: SCRIPE-Backend Auth, Middleware & Session Hardening Workflow
meta.subtitle: From pre-auth tenant lookup and 33-stage pipeline gates through $s2$ policy, Hybrid MFA, dynamic cookies, and +5ms revocation.

nodes.label: Auth Controllers
nodes.explanation: AdminAuthController and UserAuthController enforce fail-closed tenant ID decryption (422 InvalidId), [AllowAnonymous] password-policy & user logout, password change SessionResponse parity, and 410 Gone on legacy /link routes.

nodes.label: 422 / 410 Stop
nodes.explanation: Rejects malformed non-empty encrypted tenant IDs (BE-037 fail-closed) and returns 410 Gone on direct /external-logins/link.

nodes.label: CookieAuthMW
nodes.explanation: Convention-driven HttpOnly cookie interceptor resolves BrandingSettings.RefreshTokenCookie ({CookiePrefix}_refresh_token) and OidcSessionCookie, stripping body refresh tokens across login, refresh, force-change-password, and change-password.

nodes.label: OnTokenValidated
nodes.explanation: Validates scripe_iat_ms (+5ms cutoff), Redis JTI denylist, and impersonator ('imp') revocation plus live admin/user active state bypassing global tenant filters via IgnoreQueryFilters().

nodes.label: 401 / 429 Stop
nodes.explanation: Fails closed when JTI is denied, scripe_iat_ms precedes revocation +5ms, impersonator is revoked, or password-reset rate limit (5 req / 15m) triggers.

nodes.label: Ordered Walls
nodes.explanation: MiddlewarePipeline stages 23-25 enforce TrustedCidr, MustChangePasswordMiddleware (mcp=true), and RequireMfaEnrollmentMiddleware (mfa_enroll=true) with strict allowlists and camelCase ErrorResponse 403s.

nodes.label: 403 Policy Wall
nodes.explanation: Blocks general API routes with 403 Forbidden until password rotation or 2FA/Passkey enrollment completes; blocks DisableUser2FA when Require2FA lacks a passkey fallback.

nodes.label: $s2$ & OtpService
nodes.explanation: Hashes passwords with SHA-256 Base64 pre-hash + BCrypt wf 12, rejects 8,616 denylist words and 5 PasswordHistory entries, and stores keyed HMAC-SHA256 OTP verifiers (Verification:VerifierKey) plus SHA-256 ResetGrantToken records.

nodes.label: SessionIssuerSvc
nodes.explanation: Orders HybridMfaPolicy (TwoFactorPendingToken 5m + TwoFactorAttemptLockHelper) before mcp and mfa_enroll, enforces MaxConcurrentSessions, and caps AbsoluteExpiresAt at 24h, >=30d StaySignedIn, or 8h impersonation.

nodes.label: Sudo & Revoke
nodes.explanation: SudoService binds 15m HMAC tickets via distributed locks; StopImpersonation re-checks original & target revocation; logout/password-change call MarkRevokedAsync (+5ms cutoff), revoke sibling tokens, and clear BrandingSettings cookies.

cards.title: Unified Issuance & Dynamic Cookie Naming
items: Every auth channel (Password, OIDC, SAML, Passkey, Magic Link, Phone OTP, ForceChange, ChangePassword) emits identical TokenResponse shapes via ISessionIssuerService.
BrandingSettings computes RefreshTokenCookie ({CookiePrefix}_refresh_token) and OidcSessionCookie without hardcoded cookie literals.

cards.title: Fail-Closed Revocation & Impersonation Ceilings
items: Impersonation requires X-Sudo-Token + admins.impersonate, hard-caps at 8 non-extendable hours, and fails closed in OnTokenValidated and StopImpersonation if either account is revoked.
MarkRevokedAsync applies a +5ms monotonic cutoff matched against signed scripe_iat_ms JWT claims alongside Redis JTI denial.
